what: Where the bundled Lisp lives, relative to the runtime root (this checkout or an installed share/romacs, beside lisp/gnu/). Each root and its immediate subdirectories, minus excluded ones, follow GNU's load-path (crates/romacs-vm-gui/src/startup.rs runtime_load_path). The autoloads library scans the same directories (each root's own files are Romacs's runtime Lisp, preloaded or loaded on demand; its subdirectories are packages) with GNU's autoload scraper and defines what it finds as it loads; --loadup loads it into its world, before the user's init.
